name: Reluctant Hiree
subtitle: i dunno...it's shiny and all, but...
rules: This card enters play with 3 tokens on it. -- This card loses 1 strength for each token on it. -- INVEST -- COST – Pay X, where X is the number of tokens on this card. -- EFFECT – Remove a token from this card.

name: Hidden Sandwich
subtitle: forged from the remains of lesser sandwiches
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic. -- If the attached character is destroyed, destroy this card instead. Reduce the amount of damage inflicted to the character this turn to 0.
flavor: Never underestimate the deflective powers of pumpernickel.
notes: Card prints 'You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic.'; catalog has the TACTICAL keyword for it. Card says 'is destroyed' / 'damage inflicted'; catalog says 'would be destroyed' / 'damage already inflicted'. Same play.

name: Acuminous Gigantitect
subtitle: ants! you all look like little, tiny ANTS!
rules: GRAND DESIGN -- COST – Pay 2. Discard a card. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Reduce the next numeric cost you pay this turn by 6.

name: Guardforce Morphmajig
subtitle: it looks angry! what's it saying?
rules: This card can attack even if it has not been in play under your control since the start of the turn. -- If you play a card, put a token on this card. (Playing a resource doesn't count.) -- If your opponent plays a card, remove a token from this card. (Playing a resource doesn't count.) -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it.
notes: Card prints 'If you play a card' / 'If your opponent plays a card'; catalog says 'When you deploy a card' / 'When an opponent deploys a card'. Flavor is leetspeak ("Excuse me fine sirs, would you mind stepping out of teh bog?"); the M in '|\/|3' is hard to resolve at this resolution.

name: Tax Attorney
subtitle: ingenious protector of assets
rules: If your faction loses influence, reduce the amount by 1.
flavor: "What, this? Just some old junk Mr. Padamose purchased on debt and leased back to his holding company for a convertible note secured against funds owed for consultations with his subsidiary's equity partner's offshore capital advisory firm. Minus out the cost of maintenance, depreciation and interest and it's a crushing loss. He's just a poor old Mau with nothing to call his own but liens, liabilities and a spider or two."
notes: Card prints 'If your faction loses influence'; catalog says 'When your faction loses influence'.
